label: TP
reason: User input from 'Referer' header flows through URL decoding into variable 'param', which is assigned to 'bar' via an arithmetic check (500/42)+num>200 (true), then passed to printf format string '%n%s'. This allows unencoded attacker-controlled content to be written directly into HTML response, causing reflected XSS.

evidence.note: Source: User input obtained from request.getHeader("Referer")
Logic: Condition evaluates true so tainted param is assigned to bar.
Sink: bar used in printf format string %n%s leading to XSS.
